Contractor scorecard

Checklists by the contractor that filled them · NCRs by the contractor they are assigned to · click a number for the list
Grade: a score out of 100 — 60% first time right, 20% NCRs per 100 checklists (each one costs 2 points) and 20% NCRs handled within target (counted from 5 NCRs; with fewer, 80% first time right and 20% NCRs per 100 checklists). A 85 and over · B 75–84 · C 60–74 · D under 60. Not graded with fewer than 20 decided checklists. Sorted by score, best first. Hover a grade for its breakdown.
